title: KAYROS: An Anytime and Exact Open-Source Solver for Duration-Minimization Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing. A Technical Report and a Case Study in Human-AI Engineering
summary: Time-dependent routing recognizes that the same journey can take a different time depending on when it begins. Under duration minimization, even the departure time of each vehicle becomes a decision. Exact methods for this setting exist in the literature, but researchers and practitioners have lacked a ready-to-use open solver that combines rich piecewise-linear travel times, early feasible solutions and optimality claims.
